heading: Declaration setter
text:
### Declaration setter [NSTG.5.4]

Registers the **C7** series-declaration callback ([NSTG.5.5]), which
fires at DSC load rather than at sample time.

It exists for backends needing setup *before* any sample arrives —
provisioning a hypertable, installing a retention policy, validating
column types. Without it an integrator still works, but learns of each
`(schema, slot)` pair lazily, when its first sample turns up.
